title: Application Intent Map
description: The layer above an application's surfaces: jobs, flows, the decisions the product already encodes, its vocabulary, and the constraints any new feature must honor. Version 1.0, additive thereafter. purpose is null by construction (a non-null value fails validation); every job/flow/encoded_decision/vocabulary/constraint row carries an evidence reference whose kind may be 'assumption', machine-enforcing evidence-linked-or-marked-assumption. additionalProperties:false keeps any ranking, score, or verdict field out. HeyHi Confidential.

system_id.description: Generic system identifier; no client name (hermetic seal).

generated_at.description: ISO date the map was produced.

source_manifest.description: A reference to the app-manifest.json this map was derived from.

purpose.description: Null by construction. What the product is FOR is a product-strategy judgment (SKILL.md Step 3, the empty slot). A non-null value fails validation: the skill reads what the product does, it never states what it is for.

statement.description: The job story: When [situation], I want to [motivation], so I can [outcome].

surface_ids.description: The manifest surface ids that serve this job.
The manifest surface ids this flow moves through, in order.

encoded_decisions.description: The decisions the product already makes in its behavior. Each is evidence-linked or marked assumption; there is no unlabeled guess.

kind.description: A gate it enforces, a default it sets, or a thing it deliberately does not do.

meaning.description: The meaning the app gives the term, not a dictionary meaning.

constraints.description: The rules any new feature must honor. Listed, never ranked: no rank, priority, score, or severity field is permitted (additionalProperties:false).

traces_to.description: The encoded decision or capability that sets this constraint.

evidence.description: Every row carries this, or it is not written. kind 'assumption' is the explicit label for an unsupported row; an unlabeled guess is not representable.

ref.description: The surface id, the file:line, the JSON pointer, or (for kind assumption) a one-line note of what is assumed and why.
